question:
**In the given sentence, identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

‘Occupation’ means the work or job people do to earning money.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **to earning money**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace '**earning**' with '**earn**' to make the sentence correct.
